entries.name: World rule (always on)
entries.content: Magic in this world is rare, costly and feared. Anyone caught casting in public is reported to the Tidewardens.

entries.name: Vel Arun
entries.content: Vel Arun is a harbor city carved into black cliffs. Whale-oil lanterns line the switchback stairs between the docks and the upper wards. The sea there never freezes.

entries.name: The drowned bells (only at night)
entries.content: Every seventh night the drowned bells ring beneath the water, and no fishing boat leaves the harbor until dawn.

entries.name: Mira (whole word only, so 'Miranda' doesn't trigger it)
entries.content: Mira is a former smuggler with a ledger of debts she never repays. She trusts no one who wears a Tideward badge.

entries.name: Tidewardens (regex key)
entries.content: The Tidewardens keep the old breakwater and answer to no guild, only to the drowned bells.
